name: General dissatisfaction (no specific feature)
definition: Complaints that name no specific product problem, e.g. 'worst app', insults or vague anger

name: Excessive ad interruptions
definition: Free listening is interrupted by ads that are too frequent, mistimed, or loud, including interruptions during songs and promised ad-free periods.

name: Other billing complaints
definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

name: Premium-Locked Playback Controls
definition: Free users cannot use controls such as shuffle off, repeat, previous track, or song seeking, or playlists are forced into shuffle.

name: Free-Tier Song Selection Restrictions
definition: Free mobile users cannot reliably choose specific tracks, play playlists in order, or queue songs without upgrading to Premium.

name: Update Breaks Basic Features
definition: Include complaints that recent app updates removed or impaired basic functionality or made the prior experience worse.

name: Unexpected Playback Stops
definition: Music or podcasts pause, cut out, freeze mid-track, or fail to continue during playback.

name: Wrong Song or Queue Behavior
definition: Playback selects unintended tracks, alters queue order, repeats songs excessively, or fails to follow the selected playlist or playback controls.

name: Other playback complaints
definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

name: App Crashes and Freezes
definition: The app crashes, hangs, shows blank screens, or becomes unresponsive while opening or using its interface.

name: Restricted playback controls
definition: Playback controls or free-tier limits prevent users from choosing, skipping, rewinding, repeating, or controlling songs as expected.

name: Confusing or unwanted interface changes
definition: Navigation, layout, or UI updates make the app harder to use or replace useful screens with unwanted content without an option to revert or customize.

name: Playback Connection Failures
definition: The app incorrectly reports connection problems or cannot stream or load content despite an available network.

name: Unwanted shuffle and recommendations
definition: Shuffle or autoplay behavior adds or selects unwanted tracks, prevents intended playlist playback, or lacks a clear way to disable it.

name: App Sign-In Fails
definition: The Android app fails to sign in with otherwise valid credentials or supported methods, showing errors, hanging, or behaving differently from the website.

name: Subscription Payment and Entitlement Errors
definition: Subscription purchases, payments, offers, billing periods, or account entitlements fail to match what the user expected or paid for.

name: Missing or Unavailable Catalog Content
definition: Songs, artists, or albums are absent, removed from playlists, or unavailable because of catalog or regional restrictions.

name: Free-Tier Skip and Replay Limits
definition: Free users face caps on skipping or replaying songs, including limits on how often they can listen to a track.

name: Lyrics Missing or Not Loading
definition: Lyrics are unavailable, fail to load or sync, or are restricted from users who expect access to them.

name: Playlist and queue management problems
definition: Users cannot reliably view, edit, reorder, add to, or remove songs from playlists and the playback queue.

name: Other usability complaints
definition: usability complaints that fit none of the specific usability issues (Navigation, controls, layout, UI changes, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions (e.g. 'new home screen is confusing', 'too many ads between songs').)

name: Irrelevant or Repetitive Recommendations
definition: Recommendations, autoplay, or playlist playback repeat songs, suggest unsuitable tracks, or override the listener’s intended choices.

name: Slow Loading and Lag
definition: App pages, searches, playlists, or playback controls load or respond unusually slowly.

name: Downloaded Content Won’t Play Offline
definition: Content marked as downloaded is inaccessible, missing from the library, or fails to play when the device has no internet connection.

name: Phone Number Login Rejected
definition: The app rejects a previously used or valid phone number during sign-in, often saying to check the number or try another one, or fails to send an OTP.

name: App Bugs and Reliability
definition: Include reports that the app has persistent bugs, fails to work, or works inconsistently.

name: Downloads Fail or Stall
definition: Songs or episodes cannot be downloaded, the download option is unavailable, or downloads are unusually slow or unreliable to start.

name: Search Fails to Find or Play Songs
definition: Search glitches, returns the wrong result, or fails to surface a song the user is looking for.

name: Other catalog complaints
definition: catalog complaints that fit none of the specific catalog issues (Missing songs or artists, removed content, search and discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability, podcasts content.)

name: Downloaded Content Disappears
definition: Previously downloaded songs, playlists, or episodes are removed or forgotten, forcing users to download them again.

name: Account Recovery and Signup Blocked
definition: Users cannot create an account or recover access through password-reset, sign-in-link, OTP, or account-retrieval flows.

name: Repeated Unexpected Sign-Outs
definition: The app logs users out unexpectedly or repeatedly, requiring them to sign in again and sometimes preventing them from returning to the account.

name: Other downloads complaints
definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

name: Other access complaints
definition: access complaints that fit none of the specific access issues (Login, signup, password or account access problems (e.g. 'can't log in', 'account hacked', 'logged out every day').)

name: Ads and Premium Restrictions
definition: Include complaints that ad load or premium requirements obstruct use of the free app.

name: Premium podcast ads
definition: Premium subscribers still hear embedded or inserted ads during podcasts, disrupting listening despite their subscription.

name: Account Compromise
definition: An account is accessed by someone else or its credentials, email, profile, or subscription state are changed without the user's consent.

name: Download Storage Location Problems
definition: Downloads are placed on or moved to the wrong storage location, or users cannot save them to external storage such as an SD card.

name: Unwanted Podcast Recommendations
definition: Podcast shows are promoted or placed in the feed despite the listener’s lack of interest, without a way to remove them.

name: Limited Human Support Channels
definition: Customers cannot find a direct way to contact a live support agent by phone, chat, or another accessible channel.

name: Support Fails to Resolve Issues
definition: Support gives irrelevant or ineffective guidance, repeats troubleshooting, or fails to escalate and resolve the reported problem.

name: Other support complaints
definition: support complaints that fit none of the specific support issues (Contacting customer support and the support response (e.g. 'support never replied', 'no way to reach a human').)

name: Support Does Not Respond
definition: Customers report unanswered support requests, emails, or complaints, or waits that are too long for a response.

name: Unprofessional Support Conduct
definition: Support agents treat customers rudely, dismiss concerns, or behave inappropriately during interactions.
